description: This file is an HTML document containing documentation and a CodeMirror editor displaying a Go programming language source code for the prime sieve example. The embedded code is a complete Go program implementing a prime sieve using channels and goroutines.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Sends an increasing sequence of integers starting from 2 into a channel.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters out numbers divisible by the given prime from source channel and sends the rest to destination channel.

methods.name: sieve
methods.description: Creates channels and orchestrates the goroutines to compute prime numbers using the sieve process.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entrypoint to start the prime sieve process.
